added_lines: . at fatima our lady promised that if we did what she asked there would be peace in the world and that many souls would be saved. lifestyle development management and staff invite you to a mass of thanksgiving and celebrati on of our 35th anniversary on wednesday the 4th of november at 7.00pm in holy family chur ch, ballsgrove. we will gather for refreshments and chat afterwards drogheda (st mary's)

newsletter thirtieth sunday in ordinary time sunday the 25th october 2026 next sunday 1st november feast of all saints we celebrate the saints who have gone before us in faith. monday the 2nd of november we commemorate the souls of the faithful departed. the month of november is the month of remembrance. we remember all those who have died, we pray for them and honour their place of rest. parish list of the dead the parish list of the dead for culmullen and dunshaughlin is being composed at present. special envelopes available in churches, please take an envelope write the names of your loved ones who are deceased on the list inside place in envelope with your offering and return to the church or the parish office. those on our parish list of the dead are remembered at masses on all soul’s day and on the first friday of each month. confirmation next sunday we welcome candidates for confirmation and their parents to masses. please pray for them as they continue their faith journey. young adults retreat dalgan park, 6th to 8th november contact sr una 090 – 648 1666sycamore parish pastoral council meeting will take place in pastoral centre on wed 28th october at 8 pm. meet and greet this sunday in the pastoral centre, after 12 noon mass in dunshaughlin . welcome to our community of faith – recently baptised martin reilly, 51 willow grove, priests of the parish; fr seán, 01- 825 9114. fr joe, p. a. 01- 824 1976
